artifact.name: Agent Native Runner
artifact.summary: Wraps project commands as agent-friendly CLI actions with predictable inputs, outputs, and safety checks.
artifact.description_md: Agent Native Runner is an AnyClaw CLI artifact for exposing repeatable project commands to agents in a predictable way. It follows the same product direction as agent-native CLI hubs: make command-line tools discoverable, installable, and safe for agent workflows without hiding execution risk.

versions.changelog_md: Initial Agent Native Runner CLI artifact for agent-friendly command wrappers.
